interpretation: Both templates have 96 registers/thread and no reported local memory, stack, or static shared memory. Runtime occupancy==1 is still checked for the selected template; static resource counts alone are not a runtime occupancy measurement.
CG explicit input/output operations lower to STRONG.GPU opcode families; no-allocate operations lower to NA families. Static explicit load/store counts are equal across policies.
Each template retains 15 static TLD.LZ sites because warm/post loops are unrolled; these are not dynamic request counts. The real-work loop retains a distinct texture load.

Both templates retain two static CCTL.IVALL sites associated with the optional cooperative grid-sync path, and 12 LDG.E.64.CONSTANT sites in the math body. Changing explicit IO policy does not rewrite library-internal accesses.
No cache-residency conclusion follows from this static audit. Runtime profiling evidence must be interpreted separately.

checked_contracts: A physical range may be empty when its beginning exceeds atlas length; all loops then perform zero reads, checksums remain zero, and all threads still participate in chosen barriers.
Partition intervals are contiguous, non-overlapping, aligned to 32 uint4 texels and clipped at stored atlas length. Host coverage independently counts all stored and all logical coordinates.
Both inverse layouts preserve radial-even/angular-word-odd Morton semantics. Padding is warmed/probed but cannot create a logical result; tail validity is applied by unchanged word_step/epoch_word.
Every result field is explicitly stored and every frozen Lane/State field is loaded. An opaque compiler boundary retains angle loads in the word-only control.
Kernel pointer selection precedes function attributes and occupancy queries; the same selected template pointer is used for cooperative launch.
All buffer and record limits are checked before allocation. Additional pre/post checksum and SM-id buffers are included in budget/summary payload.
Texture object destruction precedes backing-mask destruction. No kernel writes to input/state/mask resources.

Real epochs verify probes and all candidates before commit_verified advances host state. Controls skip candidate verification and commit, reporting not_run, zero verified lane epochs and host_state_committed=false.
Sparse SM identifiers are checked only for unchanged before/after identity and uniqueness; no assumption that SM IDs are less than reported SM count.
No cache-capacity or pinning guarantee is hardcoded.
